name: get_prescription_status
description: Look up a single prescription by its ID and return its current status, refills remaining, and prior authorization state. Only prescriptions belonging to the member on this call can be read.

name: search_prescriptions_by_member
description: List all prescriptions on file for the member on this call. Takes no arguments - the member is bound from the authenticated session, not passed in.

name: request_refill
description: Request a refill for a prescription. Subject to real eligibility rules (refills remaining, next eligible date, prior authorization status) - the tool applies them and returns whether the refill is approved, not just the raw record. Only prescriptions belonging to the member on this call can be refilled.

name: check_prior_authorization
description: Check whether a prescription requires prior authorization and, if so, its current authorization status. Only prescriptions belonging to the member on this call can be read.
